The issuer shows very weak near-term liquidity (current ratio 0.55) and fairly high balance-sheet leverage (liabilities about 68% of assets), while EBIT is modest relative to the asset base (about 1.2%), which constrains debt-servicing flexibility. Positive operating income, substantial retained earnings, and a meaningful equity base support some resilience, but overall the profile looks more consistent with a lower speculative-grade credit.

DECISION: BB-
